chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him): When they decided to swear allegiance to 'Uthman,

key_terms.بَيْعَة: Allegiance or pledge of loyalty, specifically to a political or religious leader.
key_terms.عُثْمَان: Uthman ibn 'Affan, the third Rashidun Caliph.

ai.seo_question: What was the context of Imam Ali's statement regarding the election of Uthman?
ai.summary: This narration captures the critical juncture in Nahj al-Balagha where Imam Ali (peace be upon him) addresses the Shura committee, highlighting the tension between his rightful claim to leadership and the political pragmatism of the companions. It underscores the historical shift from the era of the Rashidun's consultative model to the emergence of dynastic rule, a theme central to Shia historiography regarding the legitimacy of early caliphs.
